title: Zero Pixel Dawn
description:
Enter a brutal post-apocalyptic world where every run is a gamble. Explore dangerous biomes, fight deadly enemies, and escape before it’s too late  or lose everything you’ve collected..

Face mutated creatures and deadly anomalies using a mix of firearms and powerful magic. Adapt your playstyle to survive each run.

Start with nothing. Gather resources, discover rare gear, and unlock experimental weapons and spells to grow stronger over time.

Between expeditions, return to your hideout. Upgrade your loadout, craft tools, and prepare for the next mission.
description_short: Enter a brutal extraction shooter where every run matters. Scavenge dangerous zones, fight enemies, and escape with your loot — or lose everything. Use guns and magic to survive a collapsing pixel world. Take risks, push deeper, and face the unknown. Will you extract or die trying?
